{{Quote|There was a last-minute report from the Tantsor system that I thought might be relevant to our discussion. The rumored activity turned out to be nothing but a small smuggling group. The searchers found no connection between them and Nuso Esva, and no trace of actual warships.|Senior Captain Voss Parck, to Grand Admiral Thrawn|<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>}}
The '''Tantsor system''' was located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]] of the [[Empire of the Hand]] received a report from searchers that were looking for elements of [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s forces in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. The report established that a small [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] group was not connected with Esva, and that there was no trace of [[Warship/Legends|warships]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tantsor system was first mentioned in the [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and included in ''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> The system was placed in grid square I-5 by [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="EAOC" />
